summary: A Chelsea estate agency appears to lose valuation enquiries to a repeated hero slide, empty links and no listings shown on the page.

findings.problem: The hero appears to repeat the same EXQUISITE PROPERTIES IN CHELSEA slide four times, and ARRANGE A VALUATION appears twice in a row.
findings.cost: Repeated blocks look like a template and weaken the main call to action.
findings.fix: One strong hero and one valuation button.

findings.problem: The menu toggle and footer icons appear to link to #, and three team email links appear to be empty.
findings.cost: Dead links stop owners and buyers from reaching you.
findings.fix: Working links and team contact details.

findings.problem: A footer appears to read CHALPELTONS and the validation field note appears visible on the forms.
findings.cost: Spelling your own name wrong costs trust with luxury sellers.

findings.problem: No properties for sale or let appear, testimonials appear with initials only, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Owners choose an agent who shows results and is easy to message.
findings.fix: Featured sold and let properties, named reviews and WhatsApp.
